job_script:
#!/bin/bash
# job.sh BINARY OUTDIR NAME DATASET [extra gmclean args]: one benchmark job under the lock, scored.
L=/home/gijsm/.rang-heavy.lock
B=/home/gijsm/Worktrees/rang/gmclean-bench
D=/home/gijsm/Build/tmp/20261102-gmclean-bench
bin=$1; out=$2; name=$3; ds=$4; shift 4
size=2048; scale=1.5; col=DATA; field=0; thr=${THR:-0.0001}; beam=10.76
if [ "$ds" = slice ]; then size=512; scale=8; col=CORRECTED_DATA; field=1; thr=0.05; beam=${BEAM_SLICE:-600}; fi
mkdir -p "$out"
s=$(date +%s.%N)
flock $L "$bin" -name "$out/$name" -size $size $size -scale ${scale}asec -weight briggs 0.5 -niter 1000000 -gain 0.1 \
  -nmiter 1000 -abs-threshold $thr -data-column $col -field $field -j ${J:-16} "$@" "$D/$ds.ms" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1
e=$(date +%s.%N)
tail -n 2 "$out/$name.log" | head -n 1 | cut -c1-170
flock $L "$B/.venv/bin/python" "$B/examples/gmclean_bench_compare.py" score "$B/outputs/gmclean-bench-20261102/prep/$ds" "$D/$ds.json" "$out" "$out/score-$name.json" --jobs "$name" --beam-arcsec $beam --force > /dev/null 2>&1
python3 - "$out/score-$name.json" "$name" "$(echo "$e - $s" | bc)" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8"))
r=(d.get("jobs") or d).get(sys.argv[2]) if isinstance(d.get("jobs") or d,dict) else None
if r is None:
    print("no score", list(d)[:10]); sys.exit()
g=lambda k: r.get(k) if r.get(k) is not None else float("nan")
print(f"{sys.argv[2]:34s} Q/Qt {g('q_over_q_truth'):.5f} Q/Q0 {g('q_over_q0'):.4e} false_px {g('false_pixels')} false_abs {g('false_flux_abs'):.5f} inner_peak {g('residual_inner_peak_abs'):.3e} model_px {g('model_pixels')} flux_err {g('total_flux_error'):.5f} wall+wait {float(sys.argv[3]):.0f}s")
PY
